name: ui-presentation-closeout-browser

screenshots.description: Corrected 390×844 campaign library showing Turkish “İnsan Büyücü” labels and catalog-resolved “Son konum: Neverwinter” without raw location IDs.

text:
**Focused localization/location-ID recheck: passed.** Reloaded the artifact, returned to the library using “Maceraya devam et,” and made no campaign resume, creation, deletion, or gameplay actions.

- Live GET `/api/game/campaign-start-options` returned 200. Its existing catalog maps `entity_id: fr:city:neverwinter` to `name: Neverwinter`; the library displays **Neverwinter** for matching cards.
- Scanned all 23 rendered campaign cards: no `fr:city:` or `location_001` raw IDs, and no English `Human`/`Sorcerer` class/race labels. Example display: **İnsan Büyücü**. Unknown legacy locations use the honest fallback **“Konum ayrıntıları macera açıldığında görünür.”** rather than an inferred place.
- Live GET `/api/game/campaigns` returned 200 with 23 IDs; the set exactly matches the initial 23 IDs captured in the earlier pass.
- The opening brand now reads **“Tek oyunculu macera · Forgotten Realms.”**

The earlier reported localization issue was present during the original acceptance pass; this focused recheck confirms the corrected library presentation. No source edits were made.
